source_summary: Queried 5 GitHub Search API surfaces saved under /tmp/radar_2026_10_03_api/ for recently created and recently pushed AI agent, MCP, computer-use, browser automation, coding-agent, RAG/workflow, agent memory, agent skills, and assistant repositories. Deduplicated about 197 repositories. Shortlisted repository metadata, root contents, and README audits were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_10_03_readmes/. GitHub unauthenticated API later returned 403 rate limit, so Top projects primarily use complete audits while some Watchlist entries are search-metadata-only.
trend_observations: Agent product work keeps moving toward local desktop workspaces, durable local execution bridges, shared memory, skill registries, and concrete business objects such as CRM conversations, web clips, metasearch APIs, and self-hosted publishing. The strongest candidates expose permissions, audit logs, receipts, downloads, tests, local storage, or self-host deployment paths as first-class product surfaces instead of only wrapping another chat prompt.
assumptions: Scores use GitHub metadata, repository descriptions/topics, root-content and README evidence, install/test/CI/security/download/example signals, created_at/pushed_at timing, and product-surface clarity. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, desktop-tested, Windows-tested, mobile-tested, MCP-connected, credential-tested, provider-tested, security-tested, payment-tested, or deployed locally. Star counts and pushed_at values are point-in-time metadata from the discovery window and can change quickly. GitHub API rate limiting prevented full audits for some late shortlist candidates; those are called out conservatively.
markdown_report: See data/runs/2026-10-03.md for the complete human-readable report. Top themes: local desktop agent workspaces, ChatGPT local execution bridges, AI sales OS, permissioned terminal agents, shared memory, multi-machine agent command centers, unattended coding receipts, governance gateways, AI web clipping, and typed long-term memory.

top_projects.summary: Electron and Rust local-first AI coding agent desktop for projects, agents, models, plugins, and workflows in one persistent workspace.

top_projects.ai_native_angle: Moves agent runtime from one-off CLI sessions into a desktop project/plugin/model/workflow container with local-first boundaries.
top_projects.growth_signal: Pushed 2026-10-03 with about 6,294 stars. Root audit found Electron/Rust workspace, apps, crates, packages, docs, examples, scripts, SECURITY, AGENTS, and release/download badges.
top_projects.runnability: High from release surface, docs, examples, and workspace structure; no desktop app, agent harness, or plugin was run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Launch the desktop app on a disposable repository and verify project persistence, plugin permissions, model switching, and local file boundaries.
